name: opencode-presence-discord
description: Discord Rich Presence for OpenCode V2 (TUI only)

scripts.build: bun build ./src/tui.tsx --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @opencode/plugin --external @opencode/plugin/* --external @opencode/client --external @opencode/client/* --external bun:sqlite --external node:sqlite
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run scripts/pack-guard.ts
